{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove rows where customer_age is a sentinel value
# Sentinel values are -1, 0, 999, 9999
filtered_df = sales_df[~sales_df['customer_age'].isin([-1, 0, 999, 9999])]

# Compute the mean age of customers, excluding sentinel values
mean_age = filtered_df['customer_age'].mean()

mean_age"}
